The workbook generation failed due to Excel #NAME? errors in the statistics section, indicating invalid formula syntax or missing named ranges.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple AssertionError messages in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected float values (e.g., H46 expected -1.5187952898550745). This error typically occurs when openpyxl writes a formula containing a function name or range reference that Excel does not recognize. While basic sheet structure and lookup blocks passed, the statistical calculations for the 'net metric' failed to evaluate.
